A high-quality, professional full-body outdoor photograph captured on a sunny tropical beach. The main subject is a young woman with a curvaceous yet slender physique and a very voluminous bust. She is standing confidently, posed in a three-quarter view (3/4 angle), looking directly toward the camera with a seductive, provocative, and highly confident expression.

She is wearing a stylish, vibrant purple bikini and high-heeled sandals, which are planted in the golden sand.

The background features a breathtaking tropical scene: soft white sand, gentle turquoise ocean waves, and a clear, bright blue sky.

The lighting is bright, natural sunlight, creating sharp, realistic shadows and highlights that accentuate her skin texture.

The composition follows the rule of thirds, utilizing a shallow depth of field (strong bokeh effect) to keep the focus entirely on the subject while softly blurring the mesmerizing ocean background.

**Style and Quality Cues:** Ultra-realistic photography, high resolution, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, sharp focus on the subject, professional editorial quality.

**Negative Prompts to Avoid:** cartoon, drawing, anime, low resolution, blurry, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, unrealistic skin, flat lighting, messy hair, poor composition.
